purpose: Internal taxonomy for planning and cataloging reusable workflow packages. Entries describe areas of opportunity, not completed products.

industries.name: Automotive, Towing & Vehicle Recovery
safety_notes: Respect local and state law, contract terms, consumer-protection rules, privacy, and required notices.
Do not automate vehicle release, repossession, access, or property disposition without authorized human review.

industries.name: Software Engineering & Repository Operations
safety_notes: Use isolated workspaces and least-privilege credentials.
Never claim a test, build, or deployment passed without captured evidence.

industries.name: Small Business Operations
safety_notes: Require user review for binding offers, payments, refunds, and customer-facing commitments.

industries.name: Home Services & Field Service
safety_notes: Do not represent estimates as binding prices unless explicitly approved.

industries.name: Logistics, Fleet & Transportation
safety_notes: Safety-critical vehicle decisions remain subject to qualified human review.

industries.name: Real Estate & Property Management
safety_notes: Apply fair-housing, privacy, record-retention, and jurisdiction-specific requirements.

industries.name: Professional Services & Consulting
safety_notes: Protect confidential client material and require approval of final advice or deliverables.

industries.name: Marketing, Creative & Digital Agencies
safety_notes: Respect copyright, brand permissions, platform policies, and disclosure requirements.

industries.name: Retail & E-commerce
safety_notes: Refunds, account changes, and customer-data exports require permission checks.

industries.name: Construction & Skilled Trades
safety_notes: Never replace required professional judgment, inspections, or safety procedures.

industries.name: Healthcare Administration
safety_notes: No diagnosis or treatment automation in this catalog. Health information requires appropriate legal, security, and access controls.

industries.name: Legal Operations & Document Administration
safety_notes: Administrative support only; legal advice, filing decisions, and deadlines require qualified review.

industries.name: Education & Training
safety_notes: Protect student data and retain human oversight for consequential decisions.

industries.name: Finance & Bookkeeping Administration
safety_notes: No autonomous money movement, tax filing, lending, or investment decisions without explicit authorization and appropriate review.

industries.name: IT Operations & Cybersecurity
safety_notes: Defensive and authorized scope only; privilege changes and disruptive actions require approval.

industries.name: Hospitality & Events
safety_notes: Protect guest information and require approval before making external commitments.

industries.name: Nonprofit & Community Organizations
safety_notes: Handle donor and beneficiary data with strict privacy controls.

industries.name: Creators, Media & Publishing
safety_notes: Verify rights, consent, attribution, and licenses before publishing or distributing assets.
